Done. Summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api's latest release, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was v2.3.0.

**Rollback:** 
- The first rollback attempt to v2.3.0 partially failed — us-east rolled back, but the rollout halted due to an orchestrator error, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1.
- A second attempt completed the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions.
- checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with the error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0"), documenting the unhealthy release, the partial-failure/retry sequence, and the restored state. It notes that root cause of the v2.3.1 failures and the orchestrator error on the first rollback attempt still need investigation.

One note: the incident creation API timed out on the response, but I verified the incident (INC-0001) was actually created and is open, so the on-call engineer has been paged.
